get_current_device: get the current CUDA device or CPU device for PyTorch tensor placement
shift_dim_tensor: permute a PyTorch tensor by moving a source dimension to a destination dimension
tensor_slice: slice a PyTorch tensor along each dimension by specifying start indices and sizes
load_module_from_url: load a PyTorch model state dict from a URL into an existing nn.Module
remove_grad: freeze all parameters of a PyTorch nn.Module by disabling gradient computation
